links.outcome: Existence and relevance of citations generated by ChatGPT and Bing AI versus human systematic review benchmark
links.effect: ChatGPT: 7 (0.5%) of 1287 studies relevant; 7 grade A, 18 B, 167 C, 211 F (fake titles). Bing AI: 19 (40%) of 48 relevant, versus 24 in the human benchmark.
links.quote: In the qualitative evaluation, ChatGPT had 7 grade A, 18 grade B, 167 grade C, and 211 grade F studies, and Bing AI had 19 grade A and 28 grade C studies.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of generative AI (ChatGPT and Bing AI) for medical literature searching for systematic reviews and clinical decision support compared to a human benchmark.
